settings.heading: Built on one of the most studied peptides in skin care.
settings.text: GHK-Cu, also called copper tripeptide-1, has been researched in skin science for decades. We formulate around it at a disclosed 1%, and we let the ingredient speak plainly rather than dress it in claims we cannot make.

settings.title: What GHK-Cu is
settings.text: A small copper peptide, naturally present in skin, used in skin care for the look of firmer, smoother, more resilient looking skin. We use it at a disclosed 1%.

settings.title: Who it is for
settings.text: Anyone who wants the appearance of firmer, more even skin and prefers a short, honest routine. It suits most skin types, including sensitive skin looking for a gentle daily step.

settings.title: How to layer it
settings.text: Apply to clean skin, then seal with moisturizer. It plays well with hydrating steps like hyaluronic acid. If you use strong acids or vitamin C, use them at a different time of day.
